title: 12: Code quality and repository cleanup for submission
head: codex/12-code-quality
body:
Documents all 374 public modules/classes/functions in `src/autoassess`, adds complete public web signatures, configures Ruff E/F/I/B/UP (120-column formatting, E501 ignored), and makes lint a CI check. Public documentation now describes current behavior rather than implementation history; key confidence, quote, injection, review-policy and ledger-lock decisions are explained.

Repository cleanup follows the spec: removes the retired offline JS demo and its parity test; removes interim reports after confirming all eight active report citations already exist in the final bibliography; relocates rules and task specs under `docs/development/` and updates navigation. The Colab notebook was removed rather than advertised as working: its gated GPU/weight installation cannot be verified in this environment. Local/precomputed OCR providers remain available. The README rewrite from main was merged intact with only a development-docs link added.

Done-when validation:
- `tests/test_docstrings.py` AST-checks every public module, class and function (including nested route handlers), rejects historical docstring markers, and checks public web arguments/returns.
- `ruff check .` passes; `ruff format .` applied. Narrow annotated exceptions preserve the public Enum representation, intentional per-sheet closure binding and optional-dependency test gating. No blanket unsafe lint fixes used.
- Required editable install succeeded. `pytest -q`: **287 passed, 1 warning in 86.30s (0:01:26)**. Existing test assertions remain intact aside from the explicitly retired legacy parity test; formatting/import/unused-local cleanups retain behavior.
- Prior implementation validation built the report and slides successfully without the archive; this session reran tests and lint. `git diff --check` passes. Task status and index are `in review` at their new paths.

No grading behavior, provider contracts, mark bounds, evidence enforcement, injection patterns or budget defaults changed. Type annotations do not introduce response-model serialization for web handlers. Task 13 has a separate PR. The user requested both PRs target main; review and merge this cleanup first.


Fresh validation on 2026-10-30 at the unchanged branch tip: `ruff check .` passed; `pytest -q`: 287 passed, 1 warning in 86.30s (0:01:26). These checks do not establish paid-model accuracy.
